messages:
elaine: Planning note 1: propose a "Developer Labs" release: 4 short tutorials (quickstarts), 1 reference app walkthrough, a light benchmark report, and a small partner spotlight. aim to convert readers to the webinar signups and repo stars. target launch in 18 days. who wants what? :calendar:
rohan: I can do the partner spotlight + outreach to two community partners. will draft a one-paragraph partner blurb and request a quote. suggest partner co-host for the webinar.
maya: I'll take two tutorials: "local dev loop" and "lightweight embeddings + search". each should be <900 words, with 2 runnable snippets and minimal deps. will include a tiny sample dataset.
chris: I'll own the reference app walkthrough and the benchmark note. will add a reproducible command and a 3-line CSV with results. suggestion for headline metric: cost per 1k tokens + p90 latency.
elaine: Good. Marketing asks: 1) a short hero stat (one line) for social, 2) 3 tweet variations, 3) landing copy for webinar. rohan/maya/chris please add hero stat and a 20-word summary with your PR.
rohan: partner ask sent to OpenTooling + NotebookFolk. asked for a 1-sentence quote and logo by EOD Tue.
maya: tutorial drafts ETA in 6 days. I'll include code blocks like: ```bash
pip install redwood-inference-cli
redwood quickstart run --sample data/sample.json
``` and a tiny Python snippet for embeddings.
chris: quick benchmark from my devbox: p90=140ms (gpu) for 256 tokens; cost estimate = $0.35 per 1k tokens on optimized instance. command used: ```bash
./bench/run --model gpt-small --bs 12 --seq 256 --repeat 50
``` will push CSV and PNG to assets/bench.

devrel-bot: CI note: docs build for "dev-labs" branch succeeded at 1793654600 UTC.
elaine: Nice. For lead routing: send signups to Marketo with utm_source=devlabs and also post a digest to #sales-inbound with top domains daily. set a threshold at >10k tokens/week to flag.
rohan: I'll add an optional "company domain" hidden field to the signup form and a company size dropdown. also add referral field for partner names.
maya: Social hero stat idea: "Ship your first refapp in 30 minutes; p90 latency ~140ms on GPU". keep it punchy.
chris: I'll draft the benchmark blurb: "Dev Labs benchmark: optimized GPU config reduced p90 by ~5x vs CPU; cost ~$0.35/1k tokens." will attach reproducible commands.
elaine: Webinar format: 30 mins (15m demo + 5m bench + 10m Q&A). prefer live coding for the reference app. schedule Wed evening PT. rohan, can partner co-host?
rohan: partner tentative yes. will confirm by Thu.
elaine: Next steps: maya to open tutorial PRs in 6 days, chris to add bench assets by 4 days, rohan to secure partner and prepare outreach copy by Tue, marketing to draft landing + social copy once hero stat and blurb are in. I'll assemble calendar invite when partner confirmed. :sparkles:
